name: 13815 · Norwich, NY
findings: ZIP 13815 (Norwich) has 265 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (12%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13815 (Norwich) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13815 (Norwich) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
